verdict.rationale: Deel offers webhooks that deliver real-time event notifications (contract, payroll, time events) which can be wired to external systems to trigger actions, and MCP tools that agents can invoke, but there is no evidence of a native rules/automation engine where a user defines 'if event X then action Y' logic inside Deel itself — webhooks only push events, requiring the user to build the triggering logic elsewhere. Missing for 10: native in-product rule/automation builder, documented examples of webhook-triggered automatic actions, evidence of condition-based rule definitions.
